+//! Read-only history for one retained, signed ObjectiveStart request.
+//!
+//! These observations never authorize submission, execution, retry or a model
+//! turn. A missing record is unknown, including after an owner restart.
+
+use serde::Deserialize;
+use serde::Serialize;
+
+use crate::AuthBusObjectiveIngress;
+
+/// An acknowledgement retained through a trusted owner response. A caller must
+/// not manufacture this anchor from an untrusted file or a guessed sequence.
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+pub struct ObjectiveJournalAnchor {
+    pub sequence: u64,
+    pub chain_digest: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+pub struct ObjectiveAdmissionQuery {
+    /// Exact original signed ingress, including its historical spawn generation.
+    pub request: AuthBusObjectiveIngress,
+    /// When supplied, it must exist and cover the returned publication. Without
+    /// it, a positive result is only the current owner's retained observation.
+    pub anchor: Option<ObjectiveJournalAnchor>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
+pub enum ObjectiveAdmissionUnknownReason {
+    InvalidQuery,
+    OwnerUnavailable,
+    JournalUnavailable,
+    NoMatchingPublication,
+    AnchorMissing,
+    AnchorMismatch,
+    PublicationOutsideAnchor,
+}
+
+/// Only the immutable publication disposition, never a current runtime phase
+/// or an external-effect outcome. Conflict does not mean the run was admitted.
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case", deny_unknown_fields)]
+pub enum ObjectivePublicationOutcome {
+    Compiled {
+        objective_digest: String,
+        hard_constraint_digest: String,
+    },
+    ExplicitAbstain {
+        objective_digest: String,
+        hard_constraint_digest: String,
+    },
+    Conflict {
+        conflict_digest: String,
+    },
+}
+
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
+pub struct ObjectiveAdmissionPublication {
+    pub run_id: String,
+    pub original_spawn_generation: u64,
+    pub issuer_id: String,
+    pub key_epoch: u64,
+    pub message_id: String,
+    pub message_sequence: u64,
+    pub expires_at_ms: u64,
+    pub signed_body_digest: String,
+    pub profile_digest: String,
+    pub publication_sequence: u64,
+    pub publication_digest: String,
+    pub chain_digest: String,
+    pub outcome: ObjectivePublicationOutcome,
+}
+
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case", deny_unknown_fields)]
+pub enum ObjectiveAdmissionOutcome {

+# Objective admission history
+
+`AgentdClient::objective_admission` reads one retained ObjectiveStart request through the existing
+control socket. The objective owner advertises `objective.admission.read` version 1.0 and owns
+the original RunStart journal. This API adds no store, witness, issuer or execution path.
+
+## Request and owner binding
+
+The existing schema-2 outer request uses the current owner spawn generation and
+`method: { "type": "objective_admission", "query": { "request": ..., "anchor": null } }`.
+`request` is the exact retained `AuthBusObjectiveIngress`, including its original body spawn.
+`anchor` optionally contains `sequence` and `chain_digest`. Owner-only socket access and the
+outer generation fence remain unchanged. Consumers must bind responses to the trusted owner,
+current spawn and exact request, and retain the query anchor; both modes share a wire type.
+
+The owner compares every stored authentication field, including signature, owner-derived scope and digest
+of the canonical typed body. It also matches run identity and the configured profile digest. This is historical
+record matching, not fresh signature authorization. Expiry, issuer revocation and a newer spawn do not erase
+matching history. New submissions still use existing current-generation, readiness and issuer checks.
+
+## Positive results and unknowns
+
+The response payload is `{ "type": "objective_admission", "outcome": ... }`. `published`
+contains `publication` with the original auth identifiers, signed body/profile digests
+and publication sequence/digest/chain. Its nested `outcome` is `compiled`,
+`explicit_abstain` or `conflict`. Conflict means a durable conflict publication, not an
+admitted run. Compiled means immutable publication, even if a later readiness, trust or
+runtime step failed; it proves no current run, model turn, final-use authority or effect.
+
+Without an anchor, a positive result is only what the current trusted owner retains. With one,
+its sequence and chain must exist in the recovered prefix, and the target publication sequence
+must be at or before it. An earlier anchor never authenticates a later publication. Anchors must
+come from a retained trusted response; deriving one from the file being checked adds no trust.
+
+`unknown` has one finite reason: `invalid_query`, `owner_unavailable`,
+`journal_unavailable`, `no_matching_publication`, `anchor_missing`,
+`anchor_mismatch` or `publication_outside_anchor`. None proves non-admission.
+Malformed outer frames, unavailable processes and transport failures likewise remain unknown to callers.
+No result authorizes resubmission, recompilation, run restart, cancellation or an effect. `RunStatus: null` stays independent.
+
+## Storage and limits
+
+The query holds the original owner mutex and reads its exclusively locked, already
+recovered journal projection. It performs no file I/O, append, recovery, truncation or
+replay-frontier update. Startup recovery can truncate an incomplete unacknowledged tail.
+An independently retained anchor detects missing or changed covered history after
+recovery, never live file tampering: even an anchored query does not re-read the file.
+Joint journal/anchor rollback is not detected. Corrupt storage can prevent daemon startup instead
+of returning an RPC response; clients must preserve unknown in that case.
+
+The existing 65,536-byte control-frame limit applies. Source text stays within 32 KiB and the
+canonical body within 48 KiB. Anchors address at most 4,096 publications. Responses contain bounded
+metadata, no source text or signature. Ledger/owner/protocol tests cover read immutability,
+recovered rollback, full request-field drift, anchor coverage, distinct dispositions and strict
+wire decoding; native qualification must additionally exercise actual owner restart and transport loss."},{"sha":"4bada98a8d59474e8283761419bac0b5bbdcb4e2","filename":"codex-rs/hepta-agentd/src/client.rs","status":"modified","additions":21,"deletions":0,"changes":21,"blob_url":"https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3/codex-rs%2Fhepta-agentd%2Fsrc%2Fclient.rs","raw_url":"https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/raw/60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3/codex-rs%2Fhepta-agentd%2Fsrc%2Fclient.rs","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/contents/codex-rs%2Fhepta-agentd%2Fsrc%2Fclient.rs?ref=60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3","patch":"@@ -158,6 +158,27 @@ impl AgentdClient {

+//! Exact-request history through the original journal owner. This path never
+//! authenticates new authority, compiles, appends, reconciles or starts a run.
+
+use codex_hepta_learning_ledger::RunStartAnchor;
+use codex_hepta_learning_ledger::RunStartStoreError;

+use super::*;
+use crate::ObjectiveAdmissionOutcome;
+use crate::ObjectiveAdmissionPublication;
+use crate::ObjectiveAdmissionQuery;
+use crate::ObjectiveAdmissionUnknownReason;
+use crate::ObjectivePublicationOutcome;
+
+impl ObjectiveRuntimeHost {
+    pub(crate) fn admission_history(
+        &self,
+        identity: &AgentdIdentity,
+        query: ObjectiveAdmissionQuery,
+    ) -> ObjectiveAdmissionOutcome {
+        let result = self
+            .state
+            .lock()
+            .map_err(|_| ObjectiveAdmissionUnknownReason::JournalUnavailable)
+            .and_then(|state| state.read_publication(identity, self.profile_digest, query));
+        match result {
+            Ok(publication) => ObjectiveAdmissionOutcome::Published {
+                publication: Box::new(publication),
+            },
+            Err(reason) => ObjectiveAdmissionOutcome::Unknown { reason },
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+impl ObjectiveHostState {
+    pub(super) fn read_publication(
+        &self,
+        identity: &AgentdIdentity,
+        profile_digest: Digest32,
+        query: ObjectiveAdmissionQuery,
+    ) -> Result<ObjectiveAdmissionPublication, ObjectiveAdmissionUnknownReason> {
+        use ObjectiveAdmissionUnknownReason as Unknown;
+
+        // Match the retained historical signature and all original claims. Do
+        // not apply today's issuer expiry/revocation as a history-erasure rule.
+        // Read access uses the existing owner-only socket and outer spawn fence.
+        let payload =
+            objective_body_payload(&query.request.body).map_err(|_| Unknown::InvalidQuery)?;
+        let claims = objective_claims(identity, &query.request, &payload)
+            .map_err(|_| Unknown::InvalidQuery)?;
+        let expected_authentication = RunStartAuthenticationV1 {
+            issuer_id: claims.issuer_id,
+            key_epoch: claims.key_epoch.get(),
+            message_id: claims.message_id,
+            sequence: claims.sequence,
+            expires_at_ms: claims.expires_at_ms,
+            scope_digest: claims.scope_digest,
+            signed_body_digest: claims.payload_digest,
+            signature: hex_bytes(&query.request.signature_hex)
+                .map_err(|_| Unknown::InvalidQuery)?,
+        };
+        let run_id =
+            StableId::new(&query.request.body.run_id).map_err(|_| Unknown::InvalidQuery)?;
+        if let Some(anchor) = &query.anchor {
+            let chain_digest = parse_digest(&anchor.chain_digest, "history anchor")
+                .map_err(|_| Unknown::InvalidQuery)?;
+            self.journal
+                .verify_anchor(RunStartAnchor {
+                    sequence: anchor.sequence,
+                    chain_digest,
+                })
+                .map_err(|error| match error {
+                    RunStartStoreError::InvalidAnchor => Unknown::InvalidQuery,
+                    RunStartStoreError::AcknowledgedHistoryMissing => Unknown::AnchorMissing,
+                    RunStartStoreError::AnchorMismatch => Unknown::AnchorMismatch,
+                    _ => Unknown::JournalUnavailable,
+                })?;
+        }
+        let publication = self
+            .journal
+            .publication(&run_id)
+            .map_err(|_| Unknown::JournalUnavailable)?
+            .ok_or(Unknown::NoMatchingPublication)?;
+        if query
+            .anchor
+            .as_ref()
+            .is_some_and(|anchor| publication.sequence > anchor.sequence)
+        {
+            return Err(Unknown::PublicationOutsideAnchor);
+        }
+        let (authentication, recorded_profile_digest, outcome) = if let Some(record) = self
+            .journal
+            .get(&run_id)
+            .map_err(|_| Unknown::JournalUnavailable)?
+        {
+            let fields = (
+                record.snapshot.objective_digest.to_string(),
+                record.snapshot.hard_constraint_digest.to_string(),
+            );
+            let outcome = match record.disposition {
+                RunStartObjectiveDispositionV1::Compiled => ObjectivePublicationOutcome::Compiled {
+                    objective_digest: fields.0,
+                    hard_constraint_digest: fields.1,
+                },
+                RunStartObjectiveDispositionV1::ExplicitAbstain => {
+                    ObjectivePublicationOutcome::ExplicitAbstain {
+                        objective_digest: fields.0,
+                        hard_constraint_digest: fields.1,
+                    }
+                }
+            };
+            (
+                &record.authentication,
+                record.admission.profile_digest,
+                outcome,
+            )
+        } else {
+            let record = self
+                .journal
+                .get_conflict(&run_id)
+                .map_err(|_| Unknown::JournalUnavailable)?
+                .ok_or(Unknown::NoMatchingPublication)?;
+            (
+                &record.authentication,
+                record.admission.profile_digest,
+                ObjectivePublicationOutcome::Conflict {
+                    conflict_digest: record.conflict_digest.to_string(),
+                },
+            )
+        };
+        if authentication != &expected_authentication || recorded_profile_digest != profile_digest {
+            return Err(Unknown::NoMatchingPublication);
+        }
+        Ok(ObjectiveAdmissionPublication {
+            run_id: run_id.to_string(),
+            original_spawn_generation: query.request.body.spawn_generation,
+            issuer_id: authentication.issuer_id.to_string(),
+            key_epoch: authentication.key_epoch,
+            message_id: authentication.message_id.to_string(),
+            message_sequence: authentication.sequence,
+            expires_at_ms: authentication.expires_at_ms,
+            signed_body_digest: authentication.signed_body_digest.to_string(),
+            profile_digest: profile_digest.to_string(),
+            publication_sequence: publication.sequence,
+            publication_digest: publication.record_digest.to_string(),
+            chain_digest: publication.chain_digest.to_string(),
+            outcome,
+        })
+    }

+fn retained(owner: &AgentdIdentity, name: &str) -> (ObjectiveAdmissionQuery, RunStartRecordV1) {
+    let mut record = record(
+        name,
+        /*sequence*/ 7,
+        RunStartObjectiveDispositionV1::Compiled,
+    );
+    let request = AuthBusObjectiveIngress {
+        issuer_id: "issuer.objective".into(),
+        key_epoch: 1,
+        message_id: format!("message.{name}"),
+        sequence: 7,
+        expires_at_ms: 1,
+        signature_hex: "07".repeat(64),
+        body: AuthBusObjectiveBody {
+            spawn_generation: 1,
+            run_id: name.into(),
+            objective_revision: 1,
+            source_envelope_json: "{\"retained\":true}".into(),
+            runtime_body_digest: digest("runtime").to_string(),
+            preference_state_digest: digest("preference").to_string(),
+            model_tuple_digest: digest("model").to_string(),
+            prompt_registry_digest: digest("prompt").to_string(),
+            artifact_set_digest: digest("artifact").to_string(),
+            authority_epoch: 7,
+        },
+    };
+    let claims = objective_claims(
+        owner,
+        &request,
+        &objective_body_payload(&request.body).expect("payload"),
+    )
+    .expect("claims");
+    record.authentication = RunStartAuthenticationV1 {
+        issuer_id: claims.issuer_id,
+        key_epoch: claims.key_epoch.get(),
+        message_id: claims.message_id,
+        sequence: claims.sequence,
+        expires_at_ms: claims.expires_at_ms,
+        scope_digest: claims.scope_digest,
+        signed_body_digest: claims.payload_digest,
+        signature: [7; 64],
+    };
+    (
+        ObjectiveAdmissionQuery {
+            request,
+            anchor: None,
+        },
+        record,
+    )
+}

+#[test]
+fn expired_historical_request_matches_after_reopen_without_changing_journal() {
+    let owner_root = tempfile::tempdir().expect("owner");
+    let owner = identity(owner_root.path());
+    let (query, record) = retained(&owner, "run.history");
+    let (journal_root, state) = state_with(record);
+    let publication = state
+        .read_publication(&owner, digest("profile"), query.clone())
+        .expect("publication");
+    drop(state);
+    let path = journal_root.path().join("journal");
+    let before = std::fs::read(&path).expect("before");
+    let journal = DurableRunStartJournal::recover(
+        OpenOptions::new()
+            .read(true)
+            .write(true)
+            .open(&path)
+            .expect("journal"),
+        digest("binding"),
+        /*max_records*/ 16,
+        RunStartRecovery::Unacknowledged,
+    )
+    .expect("reopen");
+    let state = ObjectiveHostState {
+        highest_sequences: replay_frontier(&journal).expect("frontier"),
+        journal,
+    };
+    assert_eq!(
+        state.read_publication(&owner, digest("profile"), query),

+    drop(state);
+    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(path).expect("after"), before);

+    for path in [

+        "/request/message_id",
+        "/request/sequence",

+        "/request/body/prompt_registry_digest",
+        "/request/body/artifact_set_digest",
+        "/request/body/authority_epoch",
+    ] {
+        let mut changed = original.clone();
+        let field = changed.pointer_mut(path).expect("field");
+        *field = match field {
+            serde_json::Value::Number(value) => serde_json::json!(value.as_u64().expect("u64") + 1),
+            serde_json::Value::String(value)
+                if path.ends_with("digest") || path.ends_with("signature_hex") =>
+            {

+            _ => panic!("unexpected field"),

+            state.read_publication(

+                digest("profile"),

+    }

+//! Read-only publication metadata from the active, exclusively owned journal.
+
+use super::DurableRunStartJournal;
+use super::RunStartAnchor;
+use super::RunStartRecovery;
+use super::RunStartStoreError;
+use super::validate_recovery;
+use codex_hepta_types::Digest32;
+use codex_hepta_types::StableId;
+
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
+pub struct RunStartPublication {
+    pub sequence: u64,
+    pub record_digest: Digest32,
+    pub chain_digest: Digest32,
+}
+
+impl DurableRunStartJournal {
+    /// Read already-published metadata without append, recovery or file I/O.
+    /// Absence is not proof that a request was never durably admitted.
+    pub fn publication(
+        &self,
+        run_id: &StableId,
+    ) -> Result<Option<RunStartPublication>, RunStartStoreError> {
+        if self.poisoned {
+            return Err(RunStartStoreError::Poisoned);
+        }
+        Ok(self.by_run.get(run_id).map(|index| {
+            let stored = &self.records[*index];
+            RunStartPublication {
+                sequence: stored.sequence,
+                record_digest: stored.record_digest,
+                chain_digest: stored.chain_digest,
+            }
+        }))
+    }
+
+    /// Verify a caller-retained acknowledgement against the current in-memory
+    /// prefix. This never repairs a file or grants access to its contents.
+    pub fn verify_anchor(&self, anchor: RunStartAnchor) -> Result<(), RunStartStoreError> {
+        if self.poisoned {
+            return Err(RunStartStoreError::Poisoned);
+        }
+        validate_recovery(RunStartRecovery::Acknowledged(anchor), self.max_records)?;
+        let stored = self
+            .records
+            .get((anchor.sequence - 1) as usize)
+            .ok_or(RunStartStoreError::AcknowledgedHistoryMissing)?;
+        if stored.chain_digest != anchor.chain_digest {
+            return Err(RunStartStoreError::AnchorMismatch);
+        }
+        Ok(())
+    }
+}"},{"sha":"6b74af4a80656c21fac96b49c6259f401c0ed35c","filename":"codex-rs/hepta-learning-ledger/src/run_start_publication_tests.rs","status":"added","additions":69,"deletions":0,"changes":69,"blob_url":"https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3/codex-rs%2Fhepta-learning-ledger%2Fsrc%2Frun_start_publication_tests.rs","raw_url":"https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/raw/60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3/codex-rs%2Fhepta-learning-ledger%2Fsrc%2Frun_start_publication_tests.rs","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/contents/codex-rs%2Fhepta-learning-ledger%2Fsrc%2Frun_start_publication_tests.rs?ref=60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+use super::*;
+use pretty_assertions::assert_eq;
+
+#[test]
+fn publication_and_anchor_read_retained_prefix_without_writing() {
+    let fixture = Fixture::new();
+    let mut journal = fixture.create();
+    let first = must(journal.append(Digest32::ZERO, record("run.first", b"first")));
+    let second = must(journal.append_conflict(
+        first.chain_digest,
+        conflict_record("run.conflict", b"conflict"),
+    ));
+    let before = locked_bytes(&journal.file.0);
+    for (name, receipt) in [("run.first", first), ("run.conflict", second)] {
+        assert_eq!(
+            must(journal.publication(&id(name))),
+            Some(RunStartPublication {
+                sequence: receipt.sequence,
+                record_digest: receipt.record_digest,
+                chain_digest: receipt.chain_digest,
+            })
+        );
+        must(journal.verify_anchor(RunStartAnchor {
+            sequence: receipt.sequence,
+            chain_digest: receipt.chain_digest,
+        }));
+    }
+    assert_eq!(must(journal.publication(&id("run.absent"))), None);
+    assert_eq!(locked_bytes(&journal.file.0), before);
+    journal.poisoned = true;
+    assert_eq!(
+        journal.publication(&id("run.first")),
+        Err(RunStartStoreError::Poisoned)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        journal.verify_anchor(RunStartAnchor {
+            sequence: 1,
+            chain_digest: digest("anything")
+        }),
+        Err(RunStartStoreError::Poisoned)
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn publication_anchor_detects_recovered_rollback_and_changed_chain() {
+    let fixture = Fixture::new();
+    let mut journal = fixture.create();
+    let first = must(journal.append(Digest32::ZERO, record("run.first", b"first")));
+    let retained_length = journal.durable_length;
+    let second = must(journal.append(first.chain_digest, record("run.second", b"second")));
+    drop(journal);
+    must(fixture.file().set_len(retained_length));
+    let reopened = must(fixture.recover(RunStartRecovery::Unacknowledged));
+    assert_eq!(
+        reopened.verify_anchor(RunStartAnchor {
+            sequence: second.sequence,
+            chain_digest: second.chain_digest
+        }),
+        Err(RunStartStoreError::AcknowledgedHistoryMissing)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        reopened.verify_anchor(RunStartAnchor {
+            sequence: first.sequence,
+            chain_digest: second.chain_digest
+        }),
+        Err(RunStartStoreError::AnchorMismatch)
+    );
+    assert_eq!(must(reopened.publication(&id("run.second"))), None);
+}"},{"sha":"492913779427e1ba5279d66535954a7a04e9aedc","filename":"codex-rs/hepta-learning-ledger/src/run_start_tests.rs","status":"modified","additions":3,"deletions":0,"changes":3,"blob_url":"https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3/codex-rs%2Fhepta-learning-ledger%2Fsrc%2Frun_start_tests.rs","raw_url":"https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/raw/60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3/codex-rs%2Fhepta-learning-ledger%2Fsrc%2Frun_start_tests.rs","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/contents/codex-rs%2Fhepta-learning-ledger%2Fsrc%2Frun_start_tests.rs?ref=60a3376902982d79e85173d6aaf6bd631b4c4cf3","patch":"@@ -9,6 +9,9 @@ use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;

+# Scoped native CI timeout budget verification
+
+Date: 2026-10-19. Base: `2be5fc052ae7b2e9fb08c68a3ae7e5a218ad37d5`.
+
+## Observed failure and limits
+
+[Original scoped job 117665655613](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39114831266/job/117665655613)
+ran from 2026-10-18 12:06:04 to 12:51:04 UTC and concluded `cancelled`.
+Its dependency-test step remained unfinished, and its artifact-retention step did not run.
+The job-log endpoint returned HTTP 404 `BlobNotFound` at 2026-10-19 00:54:48 UTC;
+the run artifact listing returned zero artifacts. The exact final compiler/test phase
+and a direct cancellation message are therefore unavailable.
+
+[CI required job 117680130373](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39114831266/job/117680130373)
+reported `CI dependencies did not succeed: hepta-scoped: cancelled` and exited 1.
+Rejecting that incomplete dependency is the required behavior.
+
+The fixed workflow had a 40-minute job limit while `hepta_ci_exec.py` defaulted
+to 3,600 seconds. The observed 45-minute lifetime is consistent with that outer
+limit followed by GitHub's documented five-minute forced-cancellation window.
+This attribution is an inference, not a recovered cancellation log.
+See [GitHub cancellation behavior](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-cancellation).
+
+## Configuration change
+
+Only two workflow lines change: the scoped job limit becomes 75 minutes, and its
+single executor invocation explicitly passes `--timeout-seconds 3600`.
+The executor wraps the entire dependency planner and its one `just test --locked`
+invocation, including compilation and every selected test; it does not allocate
+a separate hour to each package. The 15-minute outer allowance covers setup,
+identity checks and artifact retention. The previous setup took 54 seconds.
+
+The dynamic package selection, child arguments, locked dependencies, upload step,
+scope rules and terminal failure policy remain identical. This budget does not
+guarantee completion within an hour or artifact delivery after an infrastructure failure.
+Changing a workflow still selects `full_repo=true` under the existing scope policy.
+No exception is added to avoid that broader CI; a full-repository run does not
+itself prove that the scoped branch was executed.
